title: Neanderthal mitochondrial DNA sequenced
summary: Svante Pääbo's team sequenced mitochondrial DNA from the Neanderthal bones found in 1856 in the Feldhofer grotto, Neander Valley.
why: The first DNA read from an extinct kind of human; ancient DNA research itself began in 1984.

notes.problem: 'Differed from the mtDNA of all living humans' is not in the cited page; 'start of a new science' contradicts HC-SCI-C1984-01 (aDNA began 1984).

Cited source says only that in 1997 Paabo's team 'reported their successful sequencing of Neanderthal mitochondrial DNA'; it never says 'first'. Keep 'first' only if re-sourced (e.g. the Krings et al. 1997 paper).
